issue.title: vault-sync commits a lock-blocked fast-forward's remote changes as a local commit (git 2.47 detached auto-gc holds HEAD.lock)
issue.description:
## What happens

`bob vault-sync` runs `git fetch` and then `git merge --ff-only refs/remotes/origin/master`.
On athena (git 2.47.3, Debian 13), the fetch can start automatic maintenance *detached*
(`maintenance.autoDetach` defaults to true from git 2.47 on). The background
`git gc --auto --no-detach` runs `pack-refs` and `reflog expire --all`, and the reflog
rewrite holds `.git/HEAD.lock`. When bob's fast-forward runs into it, git updates the index
and working tree to the new commit and then fails to move HEAD:

```
12:06:18 error: git merge --ff-only refs/remotes/origin/master failed: Updating 9089b66a..18c22602
         Fast-forward
         fatal: update_ref failed for ref 'HEAD': cannot lock ref 'HEAD': Unable to create '/home/bryan/bob/.git/HEAD.lock': File exists.
```

The next cycle (`run_cycle_inner` in src/native/vault_sync.rs) sees the remote's newer file
versions as staged local edits. It commits them as `vault(athena): …` (2132d58c) and then
merges origin, which by now has later edits to the same files. The result is a both-modified
conflict, and on a `.bob/stats/**/*.jsonl` journal that conflict becomes the endless
bob-cli-81 loop.

## Evidence

- 2026-10-19: the fetch of 18c22602 at 12:06:18 rewrote all three reflog dirs at
  12:06:18.67–.69. A gc pack (pack-3466f6…) appeared at 12:06:24 and `info/refs` at
  12:06:25. At 12:06:47 athena committed the journal, sase.md, and three other notes, all
  byte-identical to Mac commit 18c22602, on top of HEAD 9089b66a.
- 2026-10-15: same signature. The fetch of 172d136b came at 05:38:57 and a gc pack at
  05:39:10, then athena committed 172d136b's journal, bob.md, and cash.md at 05:39:30.
- Sandbox with athena's git: `git commit` returns before the detached `maintenance run
  --detach` → `gc --auto --no-detach` → `pack-refs` → `reflog expire --all` sequence runs.
  With `maintenance.autoDetach=false`, `reflog expire` finished before `git commit` returned.
- Sandbox: with `.git/HEAD.lock` present, `git merge --ff-only` leaves HEAD at the old commit
  and the change staged. Rerunning the same merge after the lock clears completes cleanly.

## Fix direction

1. Run bob's vault git commands with `-c maintenance.autoDetach=false -c gc.autoDetach=false`
   (for example via ChildEnv `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT`/`GIT_CONFIG_KEY_n`). Auto-gc then finishes
   inside the cycle and under bob_sync.lock instead of racing the next git call.
2. When `merge --ff-only` fails with `cannot lock ref`, wait briefly and retry within the
   cycle.
3. Before committing at the start of a cycle, detect a leftover half-applied fast-forward:
   HEAD is an ancestor of origin/master, and every changed path matches origin/master's
   blob. In that case fast-forward instead of committing the remote's content as a local
   change.
4. Add a regression test that holds `.git/HEAD.lock` during the fast-forward.

Operational mitigation, separate and user-gated: set
`git -C ~/bob config maintenance.autoDetach false` and `gc.autoDetach false` on athena.

task_type_fields.impact: athena commits the Mac's edits as its own, which manufactures both-modified conflicts. With a .bob/stats journal involved, that triggers the bob-cli-81 infinite loop (10h45m on Oct 15, 21 min on Oct 19), during which athena neither pushes nor pulls.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/vault_sync.rs reconcile_origin_master (git merge --ff-only) and run_cycle_inner (commit of pre-merge changes)
task_type_fields.repro: On athena, see the bob_vault_sync_watch journal at 2026-10-19 12:06:18 ('update_ref failed for ref HEAD: cannot lock ref HEAD ... HEAD.lock: File exists') and commit 2132d58c, whose 5 files match Mac commit 18c22602. Sandbox: touch .git/HEAD.lock, then git merge --ff-only origin/master leaves HEAD behind with the change staged.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching athena's repeated vault conflicts: both conflict loops (Oct 15 and Oct 19) began when git's background gc held HEAD.lock during bob's fast-forward. This is the trigger, separate from the ignored-conflict-copy loop in bob-cli-81.

payload.description: This lock race is the trigger that feeds bob-cli-81's ignored-conflict-copy loop; fixing either one stops the Oct 15/19 pattern
Same vault_sync.rs cycle; each failed loop cycle re-runs run_notify
